statement.excerpt: They’re also spending most money with least assets. they’ve made the most commitments.
statement.document_title: Breaking news, and how the end might begin

our_interpretation: The plain reading makes three comparisons: greatest spending, smallest asset base and greatest outstanding financial commitments among the named providers.
The comparison group is scope, not a conditional forecast antecedent.
I use January–March 2026 for spending and March 31 for balance-sheet stocks, the latest completed quarter that could have been reported before the post.
Spending means actual expenditure, assets means balance-sheet assets, and commitments means outstanding contractual financial obligations. These are separate measures.
The metric_scope object records the spending component. Assets and commitments are stocks and require separate comparison schedules; the schema provides only one contract metric_scope.
No accounting basis is identified in the statement. USD is used as a comparison convention.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records establish all three rankings: OpenAI spent the most during the target quarter, held the fewest assets at quarter-end, and had the largest outstanding contractual commitments.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records disprove one or more of the three rankings. A mixed finding requires actual evidence supporting another component.
